messages:
Eli (AE): Orchard asked for a 15m POC sprint next Thu. Scope: streaming invoice ingestion, function/tool calls for parsing, and strict structured JSON output. Need a compact runbook: Node example, streaming recommendation, auth pattern (ephemeral creds + EU KMS option), and rough pricing for ~1M tokens/mo.
Mina (SE): I'll own the runbook. @Owen can you paste a tiny Node streaming + tool-call snippet and suggested defaults?
Owen (SDK Eng): Quick Node example (SSE preferred for simple reconnects):
```js
const RW = require('@redwood/inference')
const client = new RW({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
const s = client.stream({ model: 'redwood-chat-1', mode: 'sse' })
s.on('message', m => { try { console.log(JSON.parse(m)) } catch(e) {} })
// Tool call envelope: {"type":"tool_call","tool":"invoice_parser","input":{"text":"..."}}
```
Owen (SDK Eng): Defaults: batch_size=8, token_window=512. For low p99 latency -> batch_size=1 + KV cache. If they expect many concurrent streams, recommend reserved capacity.
Eli (AE): Can we include a strict output schema for demo and a tiny adapter so mapping is deterministic?
Owen (SDK Eng): Demo schema: invoice_number:string, date:ISO string, total:number, currency:string, vendor:{name:string}, items:[{description:string, qty:number, unit_price:number}]. I'll add a small adapter snippet to the runbook.
Pri (Security): Orchard requires SAML SSO + EU-resident KMS and 7yr audit retention for invoices. For presales POC we can provision ephemeral creds + scoped audit logs; legal clearance needed before real PHI. Also request: enable log-redaction toggle on staging.
Noel (Solutions): Ballpark pricing: hosted (gen + embeddings) ~ $650-900/mo for ~1M tokens. Reserved/dedicated add-on for steady throughput ~ $6k-10k/mo depending on GPU profile. I'll draft a one-slide tradeoffs summary.
Eli (AE): Can we get a staging instance and ephemeral creds by Monday so I can prepare the demo?
DeployBot: Staging deployed: orchard-integ-staging at https://staging.orchard.redwood — ephemeral creds emailed to eli@orchard.com (24h).
Mina (SE): Runbook checklist I'll include: 1) handshake + ephemeral creds sample, 2) SSE streaming snippet, 3) toolcall adapter, 4) strict schema + validation harness, 5) pricing ballpark, 6) security appendix link.
Pri (Security): I'll upload the security appendix (SSO/KMS/audit) and note redaction steps.
Owen (SDK Eng): Uploaded adapter + small tests to the runbook. Note: ensure customer parser returns exact schema keys to avoid brittle mappings.
Noel (Solutions): Pricing slide and tradeoffs uploaded.
Eli (AE): Thanks team — please give a quick thumbs-up when final so I can share with the customer. :rocket:
Mina (SE): Got it, will finalize by EOD.
Owen (SDK Eng): Done.
Pri (Security): Done.
Noel (Solutions): Done.
Eli (AE): Closing thread, see you on the kickoff.
